abstract: In this issue of Cell, Lin et al. present a new adeno-associated virus (AAV)-based toolbox that enables efficient expression of full-length proteins exceeding the conventional single-vector packaging limit. This technology overcomes key limitations of existing dual AAV vector strategies and broadens the applicability of AAV-mediated gene replacement and gene editing strategies to a wider range of genetic disorders.
